4408548690.description: On Black. 1039-42. Winter still have Sweden in a very firm grip. I commute every day to Stockholm from the North Pole (Uppsala). It's a trial. Every day is like a miniature polar expedition with cold, snow, poor road conditions and trains not running or running too late. This image was captured last night (March 4) in a small but anoying snowstorm. Today it's sunny and -10 degrees outside. Where's spring? Stitched Panorama (Autopano Pro, 4 portrait images, hand held, F/1.4, ISO 800, 1/100-1/125 s.) This is a image licensed: Creative Commons: BY. Use the image if you like!

17038381090.description:
3M00021. Canon EOS M3 & 85LII @ f/1.2 (CR2 in DPP4 -> TIFF -> LR5)

My Canon EOS M3 arrived today. Really impressed with build quality, features and image quality. They fixed all annoying quirks on the EOS M. The AF is quite fast and accurate, even with EF lenses (tested the 85LII, 50L and 24LII). Focus peaking is great for MF. Dedicated back focus button (on *) and screen off button (on Rec) suits my workflow.

The Canon Remote app works fine for remote shooting (on android).

How often will I carry my 5DIII brick?
